description: The tester's tool stack, the commit-time test options, the per-scope test-run policy, the bounded default suite set the long-running test thresholds and the two run-budget numbers. The tool list is read-only here and changes only through the tester's user-approval flow; the two commit_* keys, the three test_run_* keys and test_default_suite_set are plain strings you can set, and the two *_threshold_seconds keys, full_run_confirm_file_count and ask_before_run_seconds are integers.

keys.label: Test tools
keys.description: One entry per test type (unit, integration, e2e, sast, vulnerability, performance, coverage); changed only with the user's approval.
keys.pointer: agents/tester.md (Tool Stack Management: tools are added only with user approval)

keys.label: Commit test prompt default
keys.description: The answer j.commit's test prompt assumes without asking: skip, scoped or full; empty means no recorded default, so it always prompts.

keys.label: Commit test scope map file
keys.description: Relative path to the .json file mapping changed paths to the tests a scoped commit-time run executes; no leading slash and no .. segment.

keys.label: Task test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before a task is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.

keys.label: Story test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before a story is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.

keys.label: Epic test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before an epic is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.

keys.label: Bounded default suite set
keys.description: The bounded default suite set: a comma-separated list of root-relative test-file globs a scoped gate runs when the changed files map to no suite at all. It is the floor beneath a scoped run, never the full catalog and never empty; a value resolving to every runnable test file is refused as a misconfiguration, and one resolving to none is refused rather than reported as a pass. Empty means not configured. Globs, not suite ids, because a suite here is a whole test directory.

keys.label: Pre-push gate threshold (seconds)
keys.description: A shipping test file whose runtime, run alone, exceeds this many seconds is too slow for the pre-push test gate and is a candidate for the gate's exclusion list (it still runs in local runs); read only through skills/j-test/scripts/test-thresholds.sh.

keys.label: Manual-only threshold (seconds)
keys.description: A test file whose runtime, run alone, exceeds this many seconds should be tagged manual-only (never run automatically, even locally); an advisory figure for the human tagging it, because the in-file marker, not this number, defines a manual-only file; read only through skills/j-test/scripts/test-thresholds.sh.

keys.label: Full-run confirm file count
keys.description: A test-runner selection of more test files than this is refused unless the caller passes --confirm-full, so an expensive run is always a deliberate choice; read only through skills/j-test/scripts/test-thresholds.sh (get confirm-file-count).

keys.label: Ask-before-run threshold (seconds)
keys.description: An agent asks the user before starting a test run whose up-front estimate (scripts/test-estimate.sh) exceeds this many seconds; read only through skills/j-test/scripts/test-thresholds.sh (get ask-before-run).
